summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by ensuring recursive evaluation of arguments in the _eval_evalf method. However, it introduces a potential performance regression and could benefit from additional clarity.

issues.description: The patch evaluates all arguments with evalf(prec) before calling _imp_. This could lead to unnecessary evaluations, especially if _imp_ can handle some arguments symbolically or if some arguments do not need high precision.
The comment 'Evaluate arguments first' could be more descriptive. It might be helpful to clarify why arguments are being evaluated before passing them to _imp_.
